summary: uniQure N.V. filed a prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 4,945,055 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, with an underwriters' option for an additional 741,758 shares. The offering is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds of approximately $211.5 million will go to the issuer for general corporate purposes. The shares trade on Nasdaq under QURE. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction.
